svg.title: AeroHub: Offline Adaptation, Online Runtime, Benchmark, Training and Gallery
svg.desc: Target architecture. Human download and automatic selection both trigger the Offline Agent, guided by adaptation skills, to deliver PC or board packages and capability cards. Online Runtime includes four tools, basic behaviors, interchangeable state-estimation and perception providers, inference, control, sensors and platform interfaces. Same-type benchmarks publish a leaderboard and inform selection. Gallery automatically presents runtime effects. Training remains conceptual.
